attempts.summary: Configured a persistent NFSv4.2 share from node1 to node2 with matching dataops UID/GID 4500, setgid mode 2770, SELinux/firewall support, and verified bidirectional access. Both nodes restarted sequentially and recovered successfully without changing RHEL 10.0 or kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.
